_about: Breakdowns (F23, GDD §5). Every machine's health is 0..1 (1 = fine). Numbers are v1's (complicationConfig.ts), as fractions instead of %. unlockRank = the starting rank from which the machine can break. consoleTimeScale = how fast the shift runs while you're at the console mid-shift (the game multiplies tick time by it; the engine never reads it). cooldown: after a repair a machine can't break for max(minSeconds, maxSeconds - (rank - unlockRank)) seconds; meanwhile its meter still moves but stays at least `margin` above its break point.

laser._about: health = capacitor charge. Drains per zapped goop cell, refills per landed piece (not while broken). Breaks at 0: a first zap only primes a group, a second zap pops it.

visor._about: health = signal (was v1's lights). Holds for graceMs after you last fast-dropped, then fades from 1 to breakAt over fadeMs; fast-dropping recovers it at recoverPerSec. At breakAt it breaks and drops to brokenHealth. The game draws a glitch from health (lower = glitchier).

controls._about: heat = 1 - health. Each tank turn adds heatPerSpin; after coolDelayMs with no turn it cools at coolPerSec. Breaks at heat 1 (the input layer slows held turns; the engine only reports it). heldSpinSlowdown = while broken, a held turn (key or sideways drag) repeats this many times slower (src/input; single presses and quick swipes stay the same).
